title: CORRECT: FIPS provider count uses atomic_dec_if_positive with WARN on double-unregister
description: registry.c:161 uses atomic_dec_if_positive (not atomic_dec) when decrementing fips_provider_count in crypto2dev_unregister_provider. If unregister is called twice on the same FIPS provider, the second call finds the count already at 0, does not decrement (cannot go negative), and fires WARN(1,...). Why it is right: a simple atomic_dec would allow the count to go negative, which reads as 0 (non-positive), silently disabling FIPS enforcement without any log. atomic_dec_if_positive + WARN is the correct hardened pattern. What a reviewer might suggest: 'simplify to atomic_dec — double-unregister is a bug in the caller, not our problem.' That would be wrong: it silently subverts FIPS enforcement. The WARN is the correct response to a caller bug; the refusal to decrement below zero preserves enforcement semantics.
